target_buyer_1.type: Bed & Breakfast / Boutique Hotel / Winery / Spa
target_buyer_1.address: Geneva-on-the-Lake, OH (Southern Shore of Lake Erie)
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Premier lakeside accommodation providing all-inclusive Ohio Wine Country experience. Features 8 inn rooms, 3 two-bedroom cottages, 3 premium lakeview suites, on-site winery with locally-made wine, farm-to-table Crosswinds Grille restaurant, and full-service spa. Complimentary breakfast baskets, lakefront patios, proximity to 30+ wineries and 19 covered bridges. Family-owned operations would benefit from AI-powered guest communications and automated booking confirmations for complex multi-service stays.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Historic Victorian B&B listed on National Register of Historic Places, nearly 140 years old. Restored to original state with original woodwork preserved. Offers 9 uniquely decorated guest rooms, suites, and heated cottages. Located directly across from Lake Erie on 'The Strip' in Ohio's First Resort Village. Wrap-around front porch with white wicker seating. High seasonal demand during summer months. Independent property that would benefit from modern booking confirmation automation while maintaining historic charm.
